verdict.rationale: Expensify's own travel pages describe a corporate travel management solution with in-platform booking of flights, hotels, cars and rail, so the core booking capability is documented. Nothing in the evidence shows travel policy being enforced at booking time, which is the central differentiator of this story. Missing for 10: documented booking-time travel policy enforcement (e.g., out-of-policy blocking or approval before booking), in-depth travel docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of the booking flow.
